name: L-Theanine
summary: L-theanine is a green tea amino acid for calm focus with ~135,000 monthly searches. RCTs include AlphaWave 400 mg/day (n=30 stressed adults, stress down and Stroop reaction time improved ~21%, PMID 38758503) and Hidese 2019 crossover (n=30, depression/anxiety/sleep scores improved, PMID 31623400). Usually sold stacked with caffeine; standalone evidence is solid but narrower than stack marketing implies.
description: Canonical L-theanine research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until standalone vs caffeine-stack evidence boundaries are explicit and dose-response documentation has passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: alpha brain wave activity; glutamate/GABA modulation; stress response
